pages.label: the four parts  ·  1 of 4
title: RETRIEVAL
body: Most context failures are retrieval failures.
The model did not lack smarts.
It lacked the document that mattered.
Fix the index before you touch the prompt.
pages.takeaway: You cannot prompt your way past a bad index.

pages.label: the four parts  ·  2 of 4
title: COMPACTION
body: The window fills. Something must go.
What you drop decides what the model
pages.takeaway: What you drop matters more than what you keep.

pages.label: the four parts  ·  3 of 4
title: TOKEN BUDGETS
body: Then budget like it is money.
pages.takeaway: The window is a budget, not a warehouse.

pages.label: the four parts  ·  4 of 4
title: TOOL SCHEMAS
body: Every tool call is a contract.
Bad schema, bad call, bad recovery loop.
The model obeys the interface you gave it.
Design schemas like APIs to a stranger,
because to the model, they are.
pages.takeaway: The schema is the product surface.
